segments.name: HFS – South
products: turnkey specialty rental accommodations and hospitality services
segments.description: Owns and operates lodge communities across the Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico, providing specialty rental accommodations and hospitality to natural resource development customers.
segments.evidence: The HFS – South segment reflects our facilities and operations in the HFS – South region from customers in the natural resources development industry and includes our 16 communities located across Texas and New Mexico.

segments.name: WHS
segments.description: Provides customized workforce housing, construction and hospitality services to critical mineral, power generation and data center projects in remote locations.
segments.evidence: The WHS segment was created in 2025 and includes a diverse customer base with highly customized communities, with capabilities to expand to meet growing customer demand, supporting critical mineral development, power generation, and data center infrastructure projects.

segments.name: Government
products: housing, deployment, operations and management services
segments.description: Houses and serves government contractor and agency populations at large residential centers and support communities under lease and services agreements.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Government segment was comprised of a single customer following the termination of the PCC Contract effective February 21, 2025 as discussed in Note 2.

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Operates communities in Canada and North Dakota and provides facilities management, catering and related services to third-party workforce accommodation facilities.
segments.evidence: are consolidated and reported as "All Other" which represents the facilities and operations of one community in Canada, three communities in North Dakota
